summary: Existing Demo Bank customers can apply for and receive an instant virtual credit card within the mobile banking application for immediate e-commerce use. The credit limit is determined automatically by the bank's decisioning system without manual underwriter intervention. Subsequently, a physical card is dispatched to the customer's registered address, with the annual fee waived for the initial 12 months.

business_rules.rule: Only existing Demo Bank customers are eligible to apply for the virtual credit card product through this journey.
business_rules.source_quote: We want existing Demo Bank customers to get a virtual credit card instantly in the app, so they can start shopping online right away.

business_rules.rule: The virtual credit card must be issued and made available in the mobile app immediately upon successful decisioning.
business_rules.source_quote: We want existing Demo Bank customers to get a virtual credit card instantly in the app, so they can start shopping online right away.

business_rules.rule: The credit limit assigned to the customer must be calculated and assigned via an automated decisioning process.
A physical credit card corresponding to the account must be produced and dispatched to the customer's address on file following issuance.
business_rules.source_quote: The physical card is sent later to the customer's address.

business_rules.rule: The annual maintenance fee for the credit card account must be zero for the first 12 months after account opening.
business_rules.source_quote: There is no annual fee in the first year.

open_questions.question: What are the hard eligibility criteria for existing customers (e.g., minimum age, residency status, minimum account tenure, employment status, internal credit rating)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without explicit eligibility rules, ineligible or high-risk customers might apply, leading to regulatory breaches or excessive bad debt.

open_questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum automated credit limit boundaries, and what algorithm or score cut-offs govern them?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Lacking defined credit boundaries exposes the bank to unhedged credit risk or renders the product unusable if limits are trivial.

open_questions.question: How and when is customer consent captured for external credit bureau checks and digital credit agreement execution?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Performing a hard bureau check or opening a credit line without verifiable digital consent breaches consumer lending regulations.

open_questions.question: What is the specific rejection flow, adverse action notice, and cooling-off period if the automated credit assessment declines the customer?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Lenders must provide clear explanations or statutory decline notices; poor handling will increase call center volumes and generate complaints.

open_questions.question: What security controls and authentication mechanisms are required before displaying sensitive card data (PAN, CVV, expiry) in the mobile app?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Non-compliance with PCI-DSS or weak step-up authentication will allow compromised app sessions to steal card credentials immediately.

open_questions.question: What is the trigger, SLA, and provider integration for ordering the physical card, and can the customer confirm or update their delivery address before dispatch?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Sending cards to outdated addresses leads to card interception fraud and high card re-issuance operational costs.

open_questions.question: What fee amount applies starting in year two, and how is the fee schedule communicated to the customer prior to contract signing?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Failure to disclose post-promotional recurring fees upfront violates transparent pricing and consumer credit disclosure laws.

open_questions.question: What happens if downstream credit bureau integration or card core systems experience a timeout during the instant provisioning flow?
open_questions.why_it_matters: System drops without automated rollback or clear pending states cause ghost accounts, duplicate submissions, and customer frustration.

risks.description: Failure to present pre-contractual disclosures (SECCI/APR) and capture explicit consent before automated credit granting violates statutory consumer credit regulations.
Flawed automated limit algorithms or reliance on stale internal data could lead to over-indebtedness and elevated credit default rates.
Account takeover (ATO) attackers accessing the mobile app could instantly issue virtual cards and liquidate funds before the physical card arrives.
Physical cards dispatched to obsolete addresses on file may lead to intercepted mail and operational overhead handling return-to-sender logistics.
Core banking, card management system, or credit scoring API latency could breach the real-time instant issuance SLA, stranding customer requests.
Displaying unmasked Primary Account Numbers (PAN) and CVV in-app without adhering to PCI-DSS storage and transmission standards risks major data exposure.

stories.i_want: to apply for a credit card in the mobile app and receive automated approval with an instant credit limit
stories.so_that: I can access a credit line without waiting for manual underwriting
stories.source_quote: We want existing Demo Bank customers to get a virtual credit card instantly in the app, so they can start shopping online right away. The limit is decided automatically.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer is authenticated in the mobile banking app and meets eligibility criteria defined in Q-1
acceptance_criteria.when: they initiate the credit card application and submit required credit bureau consent defined in Q-3
acceptance_criteria.then: the system executes the automated decision engine and assigns a credit limit within parameters defined in Q-2.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer does not satisfy the automated risk score thresholds defined in Q-2
acceptance_criteria.when: the automated decisioning engine evaluates the application
acceptance_criteria.then: the application is declined, no credit card account is created, and the adverse action notification defined in Q-4 is displayed.

acceptance_criteria.given: the automated decision engine encounters an external dependency timeout exceeding thresholds defined in Q-8
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer is shown a graceful pending status message, and the transaction enters an asynchronous resolution queue without duplicate card creation.

stories.as_a: customer with an approved credit card application
stories.i_want: my virtual card details to be immediately generated and accessible inside the app
stories.so_that: I can instantly initiate online purchases
stories.source_quote: We want existing Demo Bank customers to get a virtual credit card instantly in the app, so they can start shopping online right away.

acceptance_criteria.given: the credit card application has received automated approval
acceptance_criteria.then: the virtual card is active and visible within the app card dashboard immediately with available credit equal to the approved limit.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer views the newly issued virtual card in the app
acceptance_criteria.when: they perform the step-up authentication defined in Q-5
acceptance_criteria.then: the unmasked 16-digit card number, expiration date, and CVV are temporarily revealed to enable online purchases.

stories.i_want: my physical card to be automatically produced and dispatched to my address
stories.so_that: I can make in-person and chip-and-PIN transactions once it arrives
stories.source_quote: The physical card is sent later to the customer's address.

acceptance_criteria.given: the virtual card has been successfully issued
acceptance_criteria.when: the dispatch order is initiated per the process defined in Q-6
acceptance_criteria.then: an order is submitted to the card personalization bureau targeting the customer's verified residential address on file.

acceptance_criteria.given: the physical card order has been dispatched
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer checks the card management screen in the app
acceptance_criteria.then: a tracking status indicator showing physical card dispatch progress is displayed while the virtual card remains fully operational.

stories.as_a: customer accepting the credit card terms
stories.i_want: the annual fee waived for the first 12 months
stories.so_that: I enjoy fee-free credit card usage during my first year
stories.source_quote: There is no annual fee in the first year.

acceptance_criteria.given: the credit card account is opened
acceptance_criteria.when: the account billing cycles run between month 1 and month 12
acceptance_criteria.then: the system applies a 100% waiver to the annual card fee, posting zero annual fee charge to the statement.

acceptance_criteria.given: the credit card account reaches month 13 from opening date
acceptance_criteria.when: the subsequent annual fee cycle executes
acceptance_criteria.then: the standard recurring annual fee defined in Q-7 is applied and disclosed on the statement.

uat_cases.title: Verify automated limit approval and immediate virtual card generation for eligible customer
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer is an existing Demo Bank user logged into the app, meeting eligibility criteria in Q-1.
steps: Navigate to the Apply for Credit Card section in the app.
Acknowledge statutory disclosures and provide bureau consent defined in Q-3.
Submit the application.
Wait for the automated decisioning result.
Open the Card Dashboard upon approval notification.
uat_cases.expected_result: Application receives automated approval with an allocated limit within Q-2 bounds, and the virtual card is immediately visible with full limit available for spending.

uat_cases.title: Verify application rejection when customer fails automated credit assessment criteria
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer is an existing user whose risk score does not meet the automated decision cutoff defined in Q-2.
steps: Log into mobile banking app.
Initiate virtual credit card application and submit credit check consent.
Submit application for decisioning.
uat_cases.expected_result: System returns a decline decision, no credit card or account is created in the core, and an adverse action message per Q-4 is presented.

uat_cases.title: Verify decisioning handling during bureau integration timeout
uat_cases.preconditions: Core/bureau decisioning mock service is configured to simulate a latency exceeding timeout parameters defined in Q-8.
steps: Log into mobile banking app as eligible customer.
Complete and submit the credit card application.
Observe system behavior during timeout.
uat_cases.expected_result: Application does not crash or double-create account; customer is presented with an 'in-review/pending' message and queued for background reconciliation.

uat_cases.title: Verify secure retrieval and display of virtual card credentials
uat_cases.preconditions: Virtual card has been provisioned and is visible in the customer's mobile app.
steps: Navigate to Card Details on the newly issued virtual card.
Click 'View Card Number and CVV'.
Perform biometrics/passcode step-up authentication per Q-5.
Observe displayed card information.
uat_cases.expected_result: 16-digit PAN, CVV, and expiration date are clearly displayed for online checkout use, remaining visible for the configured temporary duration.

uat_cases.title: Verify physical card order dispatch generation and tracking update
uat_cases.preconditions: Virtual card has been successfully issued to customer account.
steps: Query the physical card production integration batch per Q-6.
Verify outbound payload sent to card manufacturer.
Log into the mobile app and check card tracking status.
uat_cases.expected_result: A physical card production request with the customer's current address on file is recorded, and the app displays 'Physical card ordered / in production' while virtual card remains active.

uat_cases.title: Verify annual fee waiver during first 12 months (Months 1-12)
uat_cases.preconditions: Credit card account is active and has simulated monthly billing cycle rollovers from month 1 through month 12.
steps: Execute end-of-month and end-of-year billing cycle batches across months 1 through 12.
Inspect posted fee transactions and account balance.
Generate month 12 monthly statement.
uat_cases.expected_result: Annual fee transaction is either charged and credited back as 100% waiver or evaluated to $0.00; total fee assessed for Year 1 is exactly 0.

uat_cases.title: Verify annual fee assessment at Month 13 boundary
uat_cases.preconditions: Credit card account reaches anniversary month 13 with pricing schedule configured per Q-7.
steps: Simulate system date change to 366 days post-issuance (month 13 billing cycle).
Trigger annual fee assessment batch job.
Inspect account statement and ledger postings.
uat_cases.expected_result: The standard renewal annual fee specified in Q-7 is applied and billed to the customer's credit card balance.
